query:
select
                target.id,
                target.group_id,
                target.email,
                target.iban,
                grp.path::text as "group_path!",
                grp.name as "group_name!: DIS"
            from sales_targets target
            inner join groups grp on grp.id = target.group_id
            inner join group_adminships admin
                on admin.group_id = target.group_id and admin.user_id = $1
            order by grp.path, target.id
